cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_jobs FROM jobs LIMIT 100

cases.question: Có bao nhiêu job có kỹ năng Python?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(j.id) FROM jobs AS j LEFT JOIN job_skills AS js ON j.id = js.job_id LEFT JOIN skills AS s ON js.skill_id = s.id WHERE s.canonical_name = 'python' LIMIT 100

cases.question: Có bao nhiêu job thực tập?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE title ILIKE '%thực tập%' OR title ILIKE '%intern%' LIMIT 100

cases.question: Có bao nhiêu job ở Đà Nẵng?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE location ILIKE '%đà nẵng%' LIMIT 100

cases.question: Kỹ năng nào xuất hiện trong nhiều job nhất?
cases.sql: SELECT s.canonical_name, COUNT(js.job_id) AS skill_count FROM skills AS s JOIN job_skills AS js ON s.id = js.skill_id GROUP BY s.canonical_name ORDER BY skill_count DESC LIMIT 1
